SOCIAL STUDIES — GENERAL ASSESSMENT #20
====

GRADE: Grade 7
SUBJECT: SOCIAL STUDIES
TIME ALLOWED: 45 minutes
TOTAL MARKS: 30
EXAM BODY: KJSEA

INSTRUCTIONS
----
1. Answer all questions.
2. For calculations, show formula → substitution → steps → final answer with units.
3. For multiple choice, choose the best option.
4. Check your work before submitting.

SECTION A — MULTIPLE CHOICE
----
1. Which statement about Peaceful Coexistence is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Peaceful Coexistence as rumours only.
   B. Explain Peaceful Coexistence with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Peaceful Coexistence.
   D. Say Peaceful Coexistence never happens in Kenya.

2. Which statement about Historical Development of Agriculture is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Treat Historical Development of Agriculture as rumours only.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Historical Development of Agriculture.
   C. Explain Historical Development of Agriculture with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Historical Development of Agriculture never happens in Kenya.

3. A map key (legend) is used to: (1 mark)
   A. Replace the compass rose
   B. Name the president
   C. Measure rainfall only
   D. Explain symbols used on a map

4. Which statement about Slavery and Servitude is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Slavery and Servitude never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Slavery and Servitude as rumours only.
   C. Explain Slavery and Servitude with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Slavery and Servitude.

5. Which statement about Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies.
   B. Explain Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Say Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies never happens in Kenya.
   D. Treat Entrepreneurial Opportunities in Social Studies as rumours only.

6. Which statement about Early Civilisation is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Early Civilisation never happens in Kenya.
   B. Skip evidence when discussing Early Civilisation.
   C. Explain Early Civilisation with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Treat Early Civilisation as rumours only.

7. Kenya’s capital city is: (1 mark)
   A. Kisumu
   B. Nakuru
   C. Nairobi
   D. Mombasa

8. Which statement about Self- Exploration is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Explain Self- Exploration with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   B. Say Self- Exploration never happens in Kenya.
   C. Skip evidence when discussing Self- Exploration.
   D. Treat Self- Exploration as rumours only.

9. Which statement about Human Origin is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Human Origin.
   B. Explain Human Origin with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   C. Treat Human Origin as rumours only.
   D. Say Human Origin never happens in Kenya.

10. A budget helps a family to: (1 mark)
   A. Avoid saving forever
   B. Hide all money underground
   C. Plan income and spending wisely
   D. Ignore prices in shops

11. Which statement about Historical information is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Skip evidence when discussing Historical information.
   B. Treat Historical information as rumours only.
   C. Explain Historical information with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Say Historical information never happens in Kenya.

12. Which statement about Developments in Medium of trade is most accurate for CBC learning? (1 mark)
   A. Say Developments in Medium of trade never happens in Kenya.
   B. Treat Developments in Medium of trade as rumours only.
   C. Explain Developments in Medium of trade with correct facts and a clear Kenyan example.
   D. Skip evidence when discussing Developments in Medium of trade.

SECTION B — STRUCTURED / SHORT ANSWERS
----
13. In three clear sentences, explain Fieldwork and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

14. In three clear sentences, explain Political Development in Africa 5 5.2 The Constitution of Kenya 5 5.3 Human Righ and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

15. In three clear sentences, explain Political Development in Africa and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)

16. In three clear sentences, explain The Constitution of Kenya 5 5.3 Human Rights 5 5.4 African Diasporas 5 5.5 Citiz and give one Kenyan example. (4 marks)
